function use<T extends { value: number }>(c: Combined<T>): number {
  return c.value + c.label;
}
interface Combined<T extends { value: number }> extends T {
  label: number;
}
const combined: Combined<{ value: number; label: number }> = { value: 1, label: 2 };
console.log(combined.value);
interface Empty<T extends { value: number }> extends T {}
function useEmpty<T extends { value: number }>(e: Empty<T>): number {
  return e.value;
}
